en: The little light is awake again.
This whole place is glowing now.

zh: 嗯，以后回来就认得路了呢。
en: We will know our way back.
Everyone is here. That is nice.
It finally has someone to shine for.

zh: 嗯，给夜里回家的船看看呢。
en: May it guide the boats safely home.
It is dark here… I will follow the light.

zh: 嗯，等我一下，我们一起走呢。
en: Wait for me. Let us walk together.

zh: 嗯，我听见脚步了，是我们呢。
en: Those footsteps are ours. It is all right.

zh: 嗯，火光还在，就往这边吧呢。
en: The fire is still there. This way.
Let us stay in this little circle of light.
I feel better with you beside me.
I can see you clearly now.
May I stay a little closer?

zh: 嗯，把回去的路照住了呢。
en: It is lighting our way home.
Gently now. We must not startle it.
There is another in the dark.
Let us keep this little glow safe.
We can watch it glow at home, too.

zh: 嗯，光把路照得暖暖的呢。
en: The path looks so warm in the light.

zh: 嗯，我们能看清彼此了呢。
en: Now we can see each other.
I will remember the way back.
Oh… the fire has gone out.
I am right here beside you.
Give our eyes a little time.
We can follow our footsteps back.
We will find the light together.
Wait… I think I see something.

zh: 嗯，这是我们一起发现的呢。

en: I would like to remember this moment.

zh: 嗯，带着这点小惊喜回家呢。
en: A little surprise to take home.
Look… someone left a little mark.

zh: 嗯，它一定有人珍惜过呢。

en: Another little piece of the story.
It is lovely sitting beside you.

zh: 嗯，海上也有一条银河呢。
en: There is a Milky Way on the sea, too.
We do not need a lamp here.
The breeze is so gentle tonight.
Shall we watch a little longer?
Let us not wander too far.

zh: 嗯，火把小了，该回营地了呢。
en: The torch is fading. Shall we go back?

zh: 嗯，我们一起往亮处走呢。
en: Let us walk toward the light together.
Do we still have enough wood?
A little slower along this path.
We lit up the whole place!

zh: 哇，以后回来就认得路了呀！
en: Now we can always find our way back!
Bet this light was waiting for us!

zh: 哇，给夜里回家的船看看呀！
哇，等我一下，我们一起走呀！
哇，我听见脚步了，是我们呀！
哇，火光还在，就往这边吧呀！
en: The fire is still going! This way!

zh: 哇，把回去的路照住了呀！

en: Easy! Do not scare the little guy!
Let us bottle a little sparkle!
We can bring the glow home!
Quick break, then off we go!

zh: 哇，光把路照得暖暖的呀！
哇，我们能看清彼此了呀！
en: There you are! I can see you!
Got it! I know the way back!
Hang on! My eyes need a second!
Listen! We can follow our steps!
Come on! Let us find some light!
Come here! You have to see this!
Right in this patch of light!

zh: 哇，这是我们一起发现的呀！
哇，带着这点小惊喜回家呀！
en: A little surprise for the trip home!

zh: 哇，它一定有人珍惜过呀！
哇，海上也有一条银河呀！
en: Look! A galaxy on the sea!
No lamps! The stars have this!
Even the wind is being gentle!

zh: 哇，火把小了，该回营地了呀！
哇，我们一起往亮处走呀！
en: Race you to the bright bit!
There. The beacon is burning again.
That is this whole area lit.

zh: 你看，以后回来就认得路了。
en: Good. We will know the way back.
Someone had to come back for this light.

zh: 你看，给夜里回家的船看看。
en: Now the boats can find their way home.
Dark ahead. I am keeping to the light.

zh: 你看，等我一下，我们一起走。
en: Wait a moment. We should go together.

zh: 你看，我听见脚步了，是我们。
en: Just our footsteps. Nothing to worry about.

zh: 你看，火光还在，就往这边吧。
en: The fire is still burning. This way.
As long as you are beside me.

zh: 你看，把回去的路照住了。
en: That keeps the way home lit.
A small fire does a lot of good.
Small as a grain of starlight.
There is another in the dark.
We should keep this glow safe.
It can light a corner of home.
Rest a moment before we go on.

zh: 你看，光把路照得暖暖的。
你看，我们能看清彼此了。

en: I have the way back in mind.
I am beside you. Stay close.
Listen to our steps. We can go back.
We will find a light together.

zh: 你看，这是我们一起发现的。
你看，带着这点小惊喜回家。
en: A little something for the way home.

zh: 你看，它一定有人珍惜过。
en: Someone took good care of this.
We should keep its story safe.
That fills in a little more of the story.
Just look at all those stars.
Good to sit beside you for a while.

zh: 你看，海上也有一条银河。
en: Even the sea has a Milky Way.
We can stay a little longer.

zh: 你看，火把小了，该回营地了。
en: Torch is fading. Back to camp.
Check where the nearest lamp is.

zh: 你看，我们一起往亮处走。

en: We can find our way back now.
Fire is still there. This way.
A small surprise to take home.
